visualReview.notes: Inspected all 11 current portable/source-terrain frames. Individually authored unequal-crowned twin west towers, smaller open belfry stages, pale octagonal north cone and broader south pyramid, pointed single/paired tower windows, crenels and cornices. The west front has two blind arcade tiers and a central round-headed window, three open pointed porch arches, closed wood entry and broad stairs. Raised red-tiled nave/lower aisles meet the gray transverse barrel crossing, high choir, tall pale central round apse and two lower tile-capped apses with colonnettes/blind arcade crowns. Corrected misplaced apse windows, the south crown center, overly steep nave roof, missing porch frames/paired-window mullions, two low tower windows hidden by attached aisles and a flat skyline stair block. Tower tops, apse curves and all architectural subdivisions are picture estimates.
